subject: Urgent: FinWell portal event notification & SOC 2 evidence transfer plan
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@finwell.com>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: it-security@finwell.com, alex.thomas@finwell.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Observed portal session anomalies — immediate notice

Maya —

We saw a cluster of abnormal session resets and concurrent login spikes affecting about 2% of FinWell users between 03:40–03:55 UTC this morning. Our telemetry vendor flagged it as a potential session-handling issue that may have exposed session tokens. No confirmed data exfiltration on our side yet, but compliance wants notification and supporting artifacts to complete a scoped review.

What we need from Redwood:
- Formal incident notification (timeline + statement) suitable for our SOC 2 incident binder.
- Network/ingress logs and session token rotation evidence for the 03:30–04:00 UTC window.
- Any IRP artifacts (postmortem template, triage notes) you can share under an NDA.

Can you confirm receipt and an estimated ETA for delivering the requested artifacts? We may need a redacted telemetry bundle.

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Senior Prod Ops Manager
FinWell

Attachment: finwell-session-anomaly-headers.txt (excerpt from our WAF)

From: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@finwell.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observed portal session anomalies — immediate notice

Sara — thanks for the heads up and for the headers file. I’ve notified our incident response lead (Marissa) and engineering on-call (Rishi) — we’ll triage immediately.

Quick notes / next steps from my side:
- Marissa will be your primary security liaison and will coordinate evidence packaging for SOC 2 / SIG requests.
- Karthik will own the telemetry export and ensure we include the specific TTL/session rotation logs you requested.
- We’ll provide a short formal notification email you can include in your binder plus a redacted IRP artifact you can share under your NDA.

Can you confirm whether FinWell requires SHA256-hashed filenames or any additional redaction rules for PII before we transfer? Also confirm the preference for transfer: secure Drive link vs. sftp vs. DocuSign transfer envelope.

I’ve queued an initial artifacts manifest and a redaction checklist. ETA for initial package (redacted) is EOD tomorrow (2026-11-18 17:00 PST) unless the scope increases.

—Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Customer Security (Account Lead)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@finwell.com>, maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observed portal session anomalies — artifacts & packaging plan

Sara / team —

Appreciate the prompt report. I’m taking point for the evidence transfer. Outline of what we’ll provide in the first package (redacted where necessary):

1) Timeline & formal incident notification (signed by Redwood Sec Ops)
2) Session-token rotation logs (03:00–04:30 UTC) — CSV manifest + sample entries
3) Edge/ingress logs (aggregated, IP-redacted) — gzip
4) Application-level session TTL changes and rollout notes
5) Post-incident triage notes and initial remediation steps

Please note: we will not include raw user session payloads with PII. If you need raw payloads for legal/forensic reasons, we’ll require a limited-scope DPA and a signed transfer agreement (short DocuSign).

Attachments attached to this thread: requested-telemetry-manifest.csv (manifest of artifacts we plan to include), IRP_transfer_template_redacted.pdf (redacted IRP template you can add to your binder).

Transfer plan: upload to a shared, time-limited Drive folder (link below). For higher-control transfers, we can do an encrypted SFTP drop. Tell us which you prefer.

ETA: initial redacted bundle by 2026-11-18 17:00 PST; full forensic bundle (if required and approved) within 72 hours after agreement.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/FinWell/IRP-Evidence-Transfer

—Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security Response
Redwood Inference

Attachment: requested-telemetry-manifest.csv
Attachment: IRP_transfer_template_redacted.pdf

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@finwell.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: it-security@finwell.com, alex.thomas@finwell.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observed portal session anomalies — artifacts & packaging plan

Thanks Marissa — that scope looks good. A couple quick clarifications:

- FinWell can accept the redacted bundle to the Drive link. For the full forensic set we will get the limited-scope DPA signed — I’ll route that today.
- Redaction: please remove any full UUID session identifiers and replace with hashed tokens. Hashing with SHA256 is our standard; include an index mapping file with only hashed ids.
- Can you include a short statement about whether Redwood rotated any signing keys or rotated session secrets during the window? We need that for our SOC 2 evidence matrix.

Also, have you assigned an incident number on your side so we can reference both records?

Sara
Sara Patel
Senior Prod Ops Manager, FinWell

Attachment: finwell-additional-logs-readme.txt

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: sara.patel@finwell.com, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observed portal session anomalies — artifacts & packaging plan

Sara — quick update from engineering on the artifact packaging and key rotation: 

- Incident ID (Redwood): RW-20261117-01 — please use this when cross-referencing.
- Key rotation: no global signing-key rotation occurred during the window. We rotated a short-lived session-signature key at 04:20 UTC as a precaution; notes and rotation logs will be included.
- Telemetry export: we will produce the CSVs with hashed session identifiers (SHA256) and an index file as requested.
- Expected deliverables & ETA:
  * 2026-11-18 17:00 PST — redacted evidence bundle (Drive link + manifest).
  * 2026-11-20 17:00 PST — full forensic bundle available after DPA/DocuSign executed.

I’ll upload the initial manifest and a compressed artifact folder to the Drive link once the export completes. If FinWell legal needs a specific transfer checklist, point them to the DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/Envelope/ABC-123-FINWELL

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
